cause: The independent account began daily output only on the first in-window ETF quote, omitting January 1-4. The protocol requires a complete calendar and valuation from the prior valid close.
secondary_effects: cash_only_days was lower by four in all 12 accounts
the final breadth signal was independently generated but was not copied to account signals because its execution date followed the period end
the matching period-end unexecuted rejection was absent
financial_effect: none; all overlapping daily monetary values, every trade, fees, dividends, ending assets and maximum drawdown matched
resolution: Initialize the mark from the last valid pre-window close, emit all calendar days, retain all formed signals, and record period-end unexecuted signals.
